lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: Multiple horizontal rows of high-luminance, approximately circular pixel clusters. The spatial arrangement shows higher cluster density and smaller radii in the anterior region near the branchial slits, transitioning to larger, more widely spaced centroids towards the posterior flank.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Faint vertical bands of elevated pixel intensity intersect the horizontal rows of high-luminance blobs, forming a discernible grid-like pattern of anchor nodes across the mid-lateral flank.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: Three distinct horizontal linear features are visible on the upper third of the flank, defined by a sharp vertical luminance gradient with high-intensity reflectance on the dorsal edge and localized shadowing on the ventral edge.

dorsal_fin_surface_patterning.internal_spot_density: The silhouette of the first dorsal fin contains a high density of small, high-luminance pixel clusters, distributed relatively uniformly across the visible fin surface.
